task.name: jiminy.synthesize
task.description: Guidance synthesizer — transforms filtered guidance items into cohesive narrative for agent prompt augmentation

metadata.author: reh3376
metadata.notes: The synthesizer is the final LLM call in the Jiminy pipeline. Its output is injected directly into the agent's context. Quality here directly impacts agent behavior. Think mode enables deliberate synthesis.

output_schema.description: Narrative guidance text for agent prompt augmentation

quality_metrics.name: follow_rate
quality_metrics.description: Agent follows synthesized guidance in subsequent output

quality_metrics.name: coherence
quality_metrics.description: Guidance narrative is clear and logically structured

quality_metrics.name: specificity
quality_metrics.description: Guidance is specific and actionable, not generic
